query:
SELECT sc.id, sc.subscription_id, sc.type, sc.value, sc.amount_paid, sc.status, sc.due_date, sc.asaas_payment_id, sc.payment_links
FROM subscription_charges sc
JOIN subscriptions s ON sc.subscription_id = s.id
JOIN allowed_clients ac ON s.client_id = ac.id
WHERE LOWER(ac.name) LIKE '%stenio%' OR LOWER(ac.email) LIKE '%stenio%'
ORDER BY sc.due_date DESC
LIMIT 20;
